row.title: Q-CRIT-PUBLIC-STAGE: the public stage reading is live and refuses to show a stale stage
row.body: GET /api/v1/ignition on the site Worker reads the tick Worker's /live through the TICK service binding at request time and returns stage, block, k_eff, k_self and the time of the reading; a reading older than two tick intervals (1200 s) answers 503 stale_reading with no stage. /live shows the same reading in a Stage section. OL-20261114-7: META-SIGNAL-2 carries a grep closing probe on the drain it asks for.
